_comment: このファイルには2種類の補間があります。(1) 生成時: Network Manager のような大文字スネークケースのプレースホルダーは、`vrooli scenario generate` がシナリオビルド前に置換します。実行時にはリテラル表示値として扱われます。(2) 実行時: {{count}} のようなトークンは i18next の補間で、`t(key, { count })` によりレンダー時に置換されます。アンダースコアで始まるキー（このキーのような）はセンチネルで、コード生成・パリティテスト・未使用キー監査からスキップされます。

app.title: Network Manager
app.description: Operational snapshots, DNS policy, devices, optimization evidence, and privacy controls for the current network.

layout.sidebarLabel: サイドバーナビゲーション

dashboard.title: ダッシュボード
dashboard.description: Current operational posture across snapshots, resolver, adapters, devices, policy readiness, and privacy.
dashboard.noSnapshots: No snapshots yet. Run a snapshot before optimization.
dashboard.ready: Ready when a baseline snapshot exists.
dashboard.blocked: Blocked until a baseline snapshot is captured.

snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.description: Run read-only measurements, inspect support status, findings, and export evidence.

resolver.title: Resolver and policy
resolver.description: Inspect AdGuard status, preview DNS changes, require approval, and keep rollback visible.
resolver.previewRequired: Preview a policy change before apply.
resolver.confirmation: Approval required before persistent DNS policy changes.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Inventory LAN-visible clients with identity confidence, group labels, and privacy cues.

optimization.title: Optimization
optimization.description: Create baseline-backed safe experiments, score candidates, and require approval before apply.
optimization.empty: No optimization run in this session.
optimization.comparison: Baseline, candidate, and after evidence stay together before any approval.

settings.title: 設定
settings.description: Control display preferences and verify privacy defaults before exposing sensitive network detail.
